golden_baseline_location: Live Oracle OW_BILLING via Lakehouse Federation (recon mode LIVE, approved at intake); row counts and column checksums recomputed from the source at recon time, never copied from a document.

acceptance_checks.description: Every money column is DECIMAL(14,2) end to end and reconciles exactly to the cent against the source population (TOL-1). A DOUBLE anywhere in a money lineage rejects the PR.

loaded_rows + quarantined_rows == source_rows for every table in the unit, and the quarantine count is reported next to every money figure (TOL-2). Quarantine above 5% of source rows halts the unit and escalates (STOPA-QUARANTINE).
Rerunning the job with identical inputs produces zero net change: MERGE on the declared key plus ns, proven by a second run whose recon report shows the same row counts and checksums.

Every target row carries ns, every volume path is <ns>/<unit>/..., the job accepts ns as a parameter, and the recon report states the ns it ran under. Nothing unprefixed by ow_tp is read, written or deleted.
Unbounded Oracle NUMBER columns are pinned to a declared Databricks type per D-16 rather than defaulting to DOUBLE; the mapping is recorded per column in the recon report.
billing_audit_log lands as data but is excluded from parity comparison (D-20), and its 90-day retention becomes a table property rather than a job (JOB_PURGE_AUDIT_LOG is not a unit).

planted_anomalies.description: Unbounded NUMBER columns whose scale is not declared in DDL.
billing_audit_log rows written by an autonomous transaction whose errors are swallowed, so the log is not a reliable count of business events.
planted_anomalies.reason: The source log is lossy by construction; parity against it would compare against evidence the source itself does not guarantee. Excluded per D-20 and declared here rather than discovered at rollup.

encoding_policy.byte_transparency: Values are carried through as Unicode text without re-encoding; no transliteration, no NFC/NFD normalisation, no whitespace trimming. A trailing-space-padded CHAR column keeps its padding.
encoding_policy.invalid_bytes: Unconvertible bytes are not silently replaced: the row is quarantined with reason ENC_INVALID and counted in recon.

malformed_record_policy.details: Source NULL and empty string are distinct and must stay distinct: a NULL stays NULL, a zero-length VARCHAR2 stays zero-length. Never coalesce NULL to '' or to 0 to make a comparison pass. An unexpected extra column from the source fails the unit rather than being ignored, because a schema drift no one declared is a correctness event.

empty_input_semantics.details: An empty source table lands an empty target table for this ns and a recon report with source_rows=0; it must not delete prior output for another ns and must not no-op silently.
